articles.title: Chris Mason: Another Starmer critic gets promotion as Sarwar joins Burnham government
articles.description: Months after calling on Keir Starmer to quit, the Scottish Labour leader is set to become a minister in Burnham's government, the BBC's political editor writes.

articles.title: US renews strikes on Iran as Trump threatens to attack underground nuclear site
articles.description: The US president's threat to target a key Iranian nuclear site came ahead of the 11th consecutive night of attacks.

articles.title: More women in their 20s are getting type 2 diabetes, experts warn
articles.description: England is seeing "a worrying increase" in women in their 20s developing type 2 diabetes, say experts. Here's what to look out for.
